title: fling players off map
features: -flings players off the map (you can also make them fling really high up)
script:
local arg = {
    Hit_Hum = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid,
    Hit_Pos = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position,
    Hit_HRP = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart,
    Target = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character,
    IsKnockBack = true,
    KnockBackDir = "Up",
    KnockBackPower = math.huge,
    IsBoss = true
}
for i,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    pcall(function()
        if v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then
            arg.Hit_Hum = v.Character.Humanoid
            arg.Hit_Pos = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            arg.Hit_HRP = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            arg.Target = v.Character
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remote.TakeDamageRemote:FireServer(arg)
        end
    end)
end
